meta.title: Funding sources watched for new rounds and notices
meta.method: Read by scripts/audit/funding_watch.py, daily from .github/workflows/chfa-qap-watch.yml. Every program's own page is taken from the two catalogs (data/policy/co-developer-funding-guide.json official_url; data/policy/soft-funding-status.json source_url or contactUrl), so a program added there is watched on the next run without an entry here. This file adds what the catalogs do not hold: each agency's own announcement and funding-opportunity pages, including infrastructure programs that can support housing but are not yet in the guide, and the federal searches. A watched page that changes opens an issue; it never changes a program's status. A person reads the agency's page and updates the record with a quote. Each URL below answered HTTP 200 with the title given on 2026-10-15 unless its note says otherwise.

agency_pages.title: Division of Housing Funding Opportunities | Division of Housing
agency_pages.why: DOH's own funding page, which says it lists "requests for proposals, applications, and notices of funding availabilities". (doh.colorado.gov/funding-opportunities, first listed here, is a narrower page; corrected 2026-10-15 after Codex review.)

agency_pages.title: Funding Opportunities | Division of Local Government
agency_pages.why: Local-government grants, including infrastructure and planning money that can unlock housing sites.

agency_pages.title: Energy/Mineral Impact Assistance Fund Grant (EIAF)
agency_pages.why: Energy/Mineral Impact Assistance Fund (EIAF): grants to local governments for public facilities, including water, sewer and roads. On 2026-10-15 the page read "Future cycles will be announced and are dependent on severance and federal mineral lease revenues."

agency_pages.title: Energy/Mineral Impact Assistance Fund Program Awards
agency_pages.why: Final EIAF awards for the last three cycles; a new list means a cycle has been decided.

agency_pages.title: Strong Communities | Division of Local Government
agency_pages.why: Infrastructure and Strong Communities grants for infill infrastructure that supports housing.

agency_pages.title: Community Development Block Grant - Public Facilities | Division of Local Government
agency_pages.why: Community Development Block Grant (CDBG) public facilities money for non-entitlement towns and counties, which can pay for water, sewer and street work.

agency_pages.title: Proposition 123 - Colorado Affordable Housing Financing Fund
agency_pages.why: Prop 123 Affordable Housing Financing Fund (AHFF) programs: land banking, concessionary debt and equity.

agency_pages.title: Housing Programs | Colorado Office of Economic Development and International Trade
agency_pages.why: OEDIT's housing programs, including the Innovative Housing Incentive Program and Prop 123 announcements.

agency_pages.title: CHFA: CHFA Newsroom
agency_pages.why: CHFA award announcements and new programs (the tax-credit plan itself is watched separately by chfa_qap_watch.py).

agency_pages.agency: Colorado Department of Public Health and Environment (CDPHE)
agency_pages.title: Water quality grants and loans | Colorado Department of Public Health and Environment
agency_pages.why: State Revolving Fund (SRF) loans and grants for drinking water and wastewater systems, the capacity new housing needs.

agency_pages.agency: Colorado Water Resources and Power Development Authority (CWRPDA)
agency_pages.title: Programs - Colorado Water Resources and Power Development Authority
agency_pages.why: CWRPDA finances the State Revolving Funds and its own water and wastewater loan programs.

agency_pages.title: USDA Rural Development Colorado
agency_pages.why: Rural housing (Section 515, 538) and Water and Waste Disposal loans and grants. Answered HTTP 403 to a scripted request on 2026-10-15; if GitHub's runners are blocked too, the watch reports it unverifiable and asks for a check by hand.

grants_gov.why: Federal notices of funding opportunity (NOFOs), forecasted or posted, that Colorado agencies, local governments or developers could use for housing or the infrastructure it needs.

federal_register.why: Funding notices published in the Federal Register by the agencies that fund housing and the water, sewer and broadband it needs. A full-text search alone returned mostly information-collection notices on 2026-10-15, so results are kept only when the title names a funding notice.
federal_register.title_pattern: notice of funding|funding opportunit|funding availability|allocation availability|funding round
